node.statement: The scope clause of def-hcb-datum explicitly supplies amplified column spaces only as data and notation, with no estimates. In particular, the allowed definitions provide neither an isometric identification M_n tensor S_P = S_{I_n tensor P} nor an amplified compressed-product comparison. Therefore the preceding level-one estimate cannot be promoted to arbitrary n from the allowed inputs; the former all-n claim was mathematically unsupported and has been removed.
